content: Supabase RLS pitfalls: RLS is OFF by default on tables created via SQL/Table Editor; any table in public schema without RLS is readable/writable by anyone with anon key via auto REST API. service_role bypasses RLS by design. auth.uid() must be wrapped as (select auth.uid()) to evaluate once per query not per row (auth_rls_initplan warning). Views bypass RLS unless security_invoker=true (PG15+).
